events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, took place in 1969.

angles.name: Summer of Love Echoes
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since half a million gathered for three days of peace and music. What's your favourite Woodstock moment or track?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have been 91.

angles.name: The King's Legacy
angles.copy: Forty-nine years since we lost the King. Elvis Presley's music and influence are as strong as ever. What's the one Elvis track that always gets you moving?

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Today marks thirty years since the tragic death of hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55.

angles.name: Tupac's Enduring Impact
angles.copy: Three decades on, Tupac Shakur's voice still resonates. A true legend gone too soon. What's your go-to Tupac track?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the passing of guitar legend Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 83.

angles.name: Guitar God Tribute
angles.copy: Fifty-six years since the world lost Jimi Hendrix, but his revolutionary guitar work continues to inspire. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, Abbey Road, in 1969.

angles.name: Walking the Walk
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us Abbey Road. That album cover is still one of the most famous in history. What's your favourite track from the record?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock & Roll Icon
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and attitude with The Pretenders defined an era. What's your favourite Pretenders hit?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Mad For It
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing that rock 'n' roll swagger. What's your favourite Oasis or Liam solo track?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic anthem "Imagine" in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A timeless message that still resonates today. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first-generation iPod in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Tunes
angles.copy: Remember when the first iPod dropped 25 years ago? It changed how we listened to music forever. What was the first album you loaded onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the release of the first 007 film, Dr. No, in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Six decades of 007, gadgets, and iconic theme tunes. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the best Bond song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Legendary Liverpudlian
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the indelible legacy of John Lennon. His music still inspires millions. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Genius
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedy is truly timeless. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', in 1968.

angles.name: A Blank Canvas of Genius
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles' 'White Album' dropped. A masterpiece of diverse sounds and experimentation. What's your favourite track from this iconic double LP?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Remembering the iconic Queen frontman Freddie Mercury on the anniversary of his passing; he would have been 80.

angles.name: The Show Must Go On
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain legendary. What's your favourite Queen song featuring Freddie?
